description: Failure-first operational health, bounded reliability signals, logical-interface drill-downs, announce flow, request traces, and structured events for prnsd.

panels.description: Liveness only: LIVE means the daemon published a runtime snapshot within two minutes.

panels.description: HEALTHY has no hard failures or bounded-table pressure. DEGRADED covers route eviction or table-capacity exhaustion. Interface availability is informational and shown separately. FAULT means a hard runtime failure occurred in five minutes. Host integrity is also independent.
